nodes.name: Network interface
nodes.notes:
## Definition
A network interface connects a device to a link.

## Example
An Ethernet port receives or sends a frame.

nodes.name: IPv4
nodes.notes:
## Definition
An IPv4 packet carries source and destination addresses.

## Mechanism
The destination helps a router choose where to forward the packet.

nodes.name: Firewall
nodes.notes:
## Definition
A firewall applies policy to traffic.

## Example
A rule can permit or block a packet.

nodes.name: Routing table
nodes.notes:
## Definition
A routing table records routes used to choose a next hop.

## Mechanism
Use the destination to choose an outgoing route.

nodes.name: ARP
nodes.notes:
## Definition
ARP resolves an IPv4 address to a link address on a local network.

## Example
Use a cached neighbor entry or make a request when needed.
